title: SIDESTORY: LONE TRAIL RERUN
lines: DETAILS: Lone Trail event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain rewards by completing missions in [Case Investigation] and through Technological Transformation.
REWARDS: Technological Investigation Supply (provides random materials), Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Instruction Catalogue] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★★: Silence the Paradigmatic], Rhine Tech Eco-Garden Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Flight Data Recorder Chip, etc.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Flight Data Recorder Chip] by clearing event stages. [Flight Data Recorder Chip] can be used to redeem items from [Special Case Contact, C.U.D.O.D.].
REWARDS: Silence the Paradigmatic's token, Rhine Tech Eco-Garden Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Skill Summary, etc.

The requirements to obtain certain medals for this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once logged in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Intermezzi].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.
During the Rerun, the event entry in [Intermezzi] will be changed to the Rerun event entry, and it will be restored after the Rerun ends.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Muelsyse, Ho'olheyak, Silence the Paradigmatic, and Melanite will gain more trust during the event rerun.
02 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
- EPOQUE Collection - Habitat for Silence the Paradigmatic
03 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – CULINARY RESEARCH CENTER & RHINE TECH ECO-GARDEN
DETAILS: Culinary Research Center, and Rhine Tech Eco-Garden will be available again during the event.
- Lone Trail event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
Please stay tuned for more information!
